import json,sys,tempfile,unittest
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
tempfile.tempdir=sys.argv[2]
expected=int(sys.argv[3])
names=sys.argv[4:]
sys.path[:0]=[str(root),str(root/'tools')]
suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(names)
origins={name:str(Path(sys.modules[name].__file__).resolve()) for name in names if name in sys.modules}
if len(origins)!=4 or any(not Path(path).is_relative_to(root) for path in origins.values()):
    raise SystemExit('Expected four stage-local test module origins')
print('E011_STAGE_ORIGINS '+json.dumps(origins,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
if suite.countTestCases()!=expected:
    raise SystemExit('Unexpected selected unittest count')
result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
print('E011_PURE_RESULT '+json.dumps({'testsRun':result.testsRun,'failures':len(result.failures),'errors':len(result.errors),'skips':len(result.skipped),'successful':result.wasSuccessful()},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun==expected and not result.skipped else 1)
